<mxfile host="Electron"> <diagram name="Agent 主循环时序" id="loop"> <mxGraphModel dx="-534" dy="-232" grid="0" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="0" page="0" pageScale="1" pageWidth="1150" pageHeight="880" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <mxCell id="actor" parent="1" style="shape=umlActor;verticalLabelPosition=bottom;verticalAlign=top;html=1;fillColor=#dbeafe;strokeColor=#2563eb;fontColor=#1e293b;fontSize=12;" value="用户 /
调度器" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="50" width="30" x="60" y="40" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="agent" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#dbeafe;strokeColor=#2563eb;fontColor=#1e293b;fontSize=13;fontStyle=1;" value="ReactLoopAgent（agent.ts）" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="44" width="220" x="200" y="40" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="session" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#64748b;fontColor=#1e293b;fontSize=12;" value="Session 事件日志" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="44" width="180" x="520" y="40" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="llm" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#64748b;fontColor=#1e293b;fontSize=12;" value="LlmRuntime" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="44" width="160" x="800" y="40" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="tools" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#64748b;fontColor=#1e293b;fontSize=12;" value="ToolRuntime" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="44" width="160" x="800" y="620" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="m1" edge="1" parent="1" source="actor" style="html=1;verticalAlign=bottom;startSize=8;fontColor=#1e293b;fontSize=11;strokeColor=#64748b;" target="agent" value="followup / steer / inject（kick 唤醒）"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"> <mxPoint x="60" y="130" as="sourcePoint" /> <mxPoint x="200" y="130" as="targetPoint" /> </mxGeometry> </mxCell> <mxCell id="m2" edge="1" parent="1" style="html=1;verticalAlign=bottom;startSize=8;fontColor=#1e293b;fontSize=11;strokeColor=#64748b;" value="turn()：append turn/start"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"> <mxPoint x="310" y="170" as="sourcePoint" /> <mxPoint x="610" y="170" as="targetPoint" /> </mxGeometry> </mxCell> <mxCell id="m3" edge="1" parent="1" style="html=1;verticalAlign=bottom;startSize=8;fontColor=#1e293b;fontSize=11;strokeColor=#64748b;direction=west;" value="deriveMessages（surface 投影 + 折叠补丁）"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"> <mxPoint x="610" y="230" as="sourcePoint" /> <mxPoint x="310" y="230" as="targetPoint" /> </mxGeometry> </mxCell> <mxCell id="m4" edge="1" parent="1" style="html=1;verticalAlign=bottom;startSize=8;fontColor=#1e293b;fontSize=11;strokeColor=#64748b;" value="buildRequest：request/header 折叠
+ agent/request 瀑布（provider/effort/maxTokens）"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"> <mxPoint x="310" y="290" as="sourcePoint" /> <mxPoint x="880" y="290" as="targetPoint" /> </mxGeometry> </mxCell> <mxCell id="m5" edge="1" parent="1" style="html=1;verticalAlign=bottom;startSize=8;fontColor=#1e293b;fontSize=11;strokeColor=#64748b;" value="llm.stream 瀑布：adapter → 重试中间件 → fetch"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"> <mxPoint x="310" y="360" as="sourcePoint" /> <mxPoint x="880" y="360" as="targetPoint" /> </mxGeometry> </mxCell> <mxCell id="m6" edge="1" parent="1" style="html=1;verticalAlign=bottom;startSize=8;fontColor=#1e293b;fontSize=11;strokeColor=#64748b;" value="每个 chunk 落盘 assistant/chunk"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"> <mxPoint x="610" y="430" as="sourcePoint" /> <mxPoint x="310" y="430" as="targetPoint" /> </mxGeometry> </mxCell> <mxCell id="m7" edge="1" parent="1" style="html=1;verticalAlign=bottom;startSize=8;fontColor=#1e293b;fontSize=11;strokeColor=#64748b;" value="BlockAssembler：分段 → finish kind
error / aborted / max-tokens / completed"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"> <mxPoint x="310" y="480" as="sourcePoint" /> <mxPoint x="310" y="530" as="targetPoint" /> </mxGeometry> </mxCell> <mxCell id="m8" parent="1" style="rhombus;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#2563eb;fontColor=#1e293b;fontSize=12;" value="有 toolCalls？" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="70" width="160" x="270" y="550" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="m9" edge="1" parent="1" source="m8" style="html=1;verticalAlign=bottom;startSize=8;fontColor=#1e293b;fontSize=11;strokeColor=#64748b;" target="tools" value="executeToolCalls"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="m10" edge="1" parent="1" style="html=1;verticalAlign=bottom;startSize=8;fontColor=#1e293b;fontSize=11;strokeColor=#64748b;dashed=1;" value="结果落盘 → 下一轮 step()"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"> <mxPoint x="880" y="700" as="sourcePoint" /> <mxPoint x="310" y="700" as="targetPoint" /> </mxGeometry> </mxCell> <mxCell id="m11" edge="1" parent="1" style="html=1;verticalAlign=bottom;startSize=8;fontColor=#1e293b;fontSize=11;strokeColor=#64748b;" value="completed：turn 结束
agent/turn-stopping 最后钩子"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"> <mxPoint x="150" y="590" as="sourcePoint" /> <mxPoint x="150" y="680" as="targetPoint" /> </mxGeometry> </mxCell> <mxCell id="e8a" edge="1" parent="1" source="m7" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;strokeColor=#64748b;" target="m8"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="loopback" parent="1" style="text;html=1;fontColor=#64748b;fontSize=11;align=left;" value="while(await this.turn())——内部循环到 completed" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="30" width="400" x="460" y="730" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> </root> </mxGraphModel> </diagram> </mxfile>
